name: Glavnyj Atribut Pionera
source:
A quiet, ordinary evening at the Ministry of Internal Affairs office in the city of Kalinin.
Everything seems peaceful: birds are singing outside the window, and a freshly brewed cup of coffee sits on the desk.
But in an instant, that fragile calm is shattered.
A murder has been committed at the "Sovyonok" camp, located just nearby.
The case is unprecedented on its own - but what makes it even more disturbing is that the killer’s methods resemble those of a long-forgotten murderer.

Will Semyon Persunov and Elena Tikhonova be able to solve the case?

Who fell victim to the successor of the long-lost maniac?

And most importantly - who is really behind it all?
